title: Recruiters don't send rejections at 2 a.m. Here's what does
description:
Book a 1:1: hhttps://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/book-a-1hour-career-coaching-session-with-me-eq3bs
 Get my Job Seekers Toolkit: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/get-my-job-seekers-toolkit-now

Getting rejected at 2am and don't know why? Here's a short explanation from a recruiter who's been there, done that, seen it all!

I spent over a decade recruiting at Google, TikTok, Uber, Lyft, and The New York Times. I've watched qualified people get passed over because they walked in trying to be chosen instead of trying to be aligned. So when you get rejected, it's not a conspiracy. 

These are just the practical reasons why the rejections come in at weird times. 

Oh and yes, nefarious I guess was my word of the day...
